book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho inamicha ntumiche jwa kilongoche jwa akakomana ngondo jwa ku Loma
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge nabho bhando, ajhakujhenda ku Kapelenaumo.
Kwenio akibha kilongoche jhumo jwa akakomana ngondo jwa ku Loma, jwakibha na ntumiche gwake jwanhobholila hake. Na ntumiche jwenio atehila kulwalwa tepekatepeka abhandikila kuwegha.
Nkolo jwa akakomana ngondo jhola pajhohina malobhe panane jha Yecho, ajhakwatuma ighogholo ya Akayahude, bhajhende bhakannyope Yecho ahike kunamicha ntumiche gwake.
Ighogholo hela pubhahikita kwa Yecho, bhajhakumpembelekeya hake chonde Bhambo tunyopa mkantangatile kilongoche jwa akakomana ngondo jhola, bhalongila, “Mundo jhonjo itopile kuhengelwa kilebhe chenie,
kwa nhwalo abhapala hake bhando bha ilambo hito, kabhele atuchengile nyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude kwa nhwalo gwa Chapanga.”

Bhahe, Yecho ajhakulongohana nabho, pubhaheghelila pa nyumba jha nkolo jhola, ndi nkolo jhola ajhakwatuma akakoche mundo bhanobholele Yecho, “Bhambo, chonde nkotoka kuking'aha nenga itope ndeka mwenga kujhingila nkate jha nyumba jhango.
Nambo nenga ndopi ndeka kuhika kwino. Nambo unobholele lilobhe tugha, na ntumiche jwango nalama.

Helahela namwete ndi mundo jhumii na ukindendeke, ngwete akakomana ngondo bhinalongocha. Anda ninobholile jhumo, ‘Jhenda!’ Na jwenio ujhenda, na ninobholela jhonge ‘Ika!’ Na jwenio uhika. Anda ninobholile ntumiche gwango, ‘Uhenge lende.’ Na jwenio uhenga.”

Yecho pajhohina malobhe gheniya akakangiche hake, ajhakughalambukila lilongo lya bhando gwakalongihine nagho, ajhakulobholela, “Ninalola ndeka jhuna kihobholelo ngita chenje, hilu pakate jha kilambo choha chuku Ichilahele!”
Peniya bhando bhala bhubhakajhenda kwa Yecho pubhabhujhita ukajha kwa kilongoche jwa ku Loma bhakankolile ntumiche jhola alamite.
Yecho iyokecha mwana jwa majhe nawela
Pajhomolila peniya, Yecho ajhakujhenda kubomane jha ku Naine, bhabholwa bhake na lilongo lya bhando bhakalongohine pamonga na jwenio.

Paheghelila litangala lya kujhingilila pa bomane jhela, ajhakukongana nabho bhando bhubhagheghite malelo mukindanda cha kugheghe malelo bhajhenda kumambe. Jwenio jwakawile akibha nchongolo, mwana jwabhelwike kanjika kwa majhe mundo. Na bhando bhamahele bha pabomane jhela bhakibha pamonga na jwenio majhe.
Bhambo Yecho pamonila kiya majhe nawela jhola, ajhakunobholela “Nkotoka kulela.”
Peniya, ajhakujhenda palonge jha nchekacheka gwa kugheghe malelo ajhakupapaha, na bhubhagheghite malelo bhajhakujhema nuu. Na Yecho ajhakulonge, “Nchongolo! Ninobholela, nnyimuke!”
Nchongolo jwakawile jhola, ajhakutama na kutumbuu kulonge, na Yecho ajhakukamuha kwa majhe mundo.
Bhando bhoha bhajhakukamulwa na kiholo, na bhene bhajhakunomba Chapanga, bhalongila, “Nnondole nkolo apitile kwito, Chapanga ahikite kwaghombola bhando bhake.”
Malobhe gheniya ghajhakuchobhela ku kilambo chuku Yudeya choha na ilambo henge ya pahina.
Yecho na bhabholwa bha Yohane Mbatichajhe
Bhabholwa bha Yohane Mbatichajhe bhajhakunnobholela Yohane ilebhe yoha ipitila. Na jwenio Yohane, ajhakwakema bhabholwa bhake bhabhele,
na kwatuma bhajhende kwa Bhambo Yecho bhakankonye, “Bho, mwenga ndi jhola jwahika, amu tunendelele jhonge?”
Peniya bhabholwa bhala bhajhakujhenda kwa Yecho, bhajhakunnobholela, “Yohane Mbatichajhe atitume kwino mwenga tunkonye, bho, mwenga ndi jhola jwahika, amu tunendelele jhonge?”
Machiko ghagha, pubhakibha bhankonyita Yecho akibha makwalamicha bhando bhamahele bhibhabhii na ulwalo, bhubhachikilwe na michuka, helahela bhangalola bhahoto kulola.

Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Nnyendengane mukannobholele Yohane ghoha ghumujhoha na kughabhona. Bhangalola bhilola, na bhubhalemile bhityanga, bhina malohe bhilamichwa na bhangajhoha bhijhoha na bhubhawile bhiyokechwa na akahocho bhatangachilwa Lilobhe lya Mbone.
Jhuna mota mundo jhola jwanganeka kunyeketela nenga!”

Bhabholwa bha Yohane pubhabhokita, Yecho ajhakutumbula kulilongolela lilongo lya bhando malobhe panane jha Yohane, “Punyahwila kunjenga nnyabhila kulola nike? Bho, nnyabhila kulinga litete pulipogha pogha upepo?

Bhahe, mukajhawile kulola nike? Nnyahwila kuninga mundo jwawalite ngobho ichuluchwa kwa mbijha yamahele? Bhando bhibhahwala ngobho ngita yenio na kutama kwa kuhanganila, utama majhumba gha akanahota na kukipala hake bhene!
Bhahe, unobholele nike chimukajhawile kulinga? Bho, nnondole jwa Chapanga? Tela, chakaka jwenio ndi nkolongwa kupeta nnondole jwa Chapanga jhumoyobhalile.
Jwenio Yohane ndi jwalongelwa mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, alongila, ‘Dola nintuma ntumiche gwango anongolele, palonge jhino anenganikihe ndela jhino.’ ”
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge, “Yohane Mbatichajhe ndi nkolongwa pakate jha bhando bhubhapapitwe na mwikeghe. Helahela jhojhoha jwabhii jwandina munahota gwa Chapanga ndi nkolongwa kupeta Yohane.”
Bhando bhoha, pamonga na akatola kode pubhajhohina gheniya, bhakajheketile kubhehe ndela jha Chapanga ndi telatela na bheniya ndi bhala bhubhakabatichwe na Yohane.
Nambo Mapwalichayo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhajhakukana mpangu gwa Chapanga ghukibha gwabhe, bhahe bhajhakukana kubatichwa na Yohane.
Bhahe, Yecho pajhendilila kulonge, “Bho, ninandanikiye bhando bha kibheleko chenje na kilebhe ghane? Nnandine na nike?
Ngita ichongolo ikibha itamingine paliguliho na kujhangulana kibhogha chimo na chenge, ‘Tunhonile kitolilo! Nambo mangota nkinite ndeka. Tunyembile mihambo jha malelo, nambo mangota nnelite ndeka!’
Kwa nhwalo Yohane Mbatichajhe akahikite, atehila kupunga na anywila ndeka divaye, na mangota nnyakulonge, ‘Achikilwe nchuka!’
Jwenio Mwana gwa Mundo pahikita, alila na kunywegha, na mangota punongila, ‘Munolekehe mundo hojho chajhenda kuhapatika na kulobhela, nkoche jwa akatola kode na bhibhabhii na uhakaho!’
Nambo malango gha Chapanga ghalangiwe kubhehe ghambone kwa bhoha bhibhanyeketela.”
Yecho kajha kwa Simone Mpwalichayo
Bhahe, mundo jhumo Mpwalichayo ajhakunalika Yecho ajhende kajhake akalyeghe ndalilo. Ndi ajhakujhenda munyumba jha Pwalichayo jhola na kutama kulyegha.

Bhahe, pakibha na mwikeghe jhumo pamuche gwenio jwabhii na uhakaho. Mwikeghe jwenio pajhohina Yecho abhii nkate mwa Pwalichayo atenda kulyegha, ajhakujhenda na chupa jhitengenichwe kwa lighanga lya alabachita nkate mwenio ghakibha mahuta ghighanungila petelele,

peniya mwikeghe jhola ajhakuhika na kujhema kuyeto, na kubhandikila makongono gha Yecho, kongo atehila kulela na mahole ghake ghandonyikila mu makongono gha Yecho. Peniya ajhakuhungula makongono gha Yecho kwa majhunjo ghake na kuchopa makongono ghala na kughapaka mahuta ghakibha nagho.
Pwalichayo jhola jwanalike Yecho palolita naha, ajhakuwacha kumwojho gwake, “Chakaka mundo hojho ngabhehe nnondole jwa Chapanga, ngaumanyite mwikeghe hojho chabhile, kubhehe jhuna uhakaho!”
Peniya Yecho ajhakunyangula jwenio Pwalichayo, alongila, “Simone, ngwete kilebhe cha kunobholela.” Na jwenio Simone ngajhangwila, “Chakaka mmola, dongela.”

Yecho ndi palongila, “Bhahe, pakibha na bhando bhabhele bhakajhenda kunnyahika mundo jhumo jwahenga lihengo lya kujhahikicha mbijha. Jhumo akajhahike mbijha makome amuchine na jhonge akajhahike mbijha makome nhwano.

Bhoha bhabhele pubhalepila kulepa maghambo ghabhe, mundo jwenio jwajhahikicha mbijha ajhakwalekekeya bhoha bhabhele. Bho, ndi ghane pakate jha bhabhele bheniya jwapala kumpala hake jhola jwajhahikicha?”
Simone ajhakujhanguu, “Puniwacha jwalekekiwe lighambo likolongwa jhola ndi nampala hake jwenio.” Yecho ajhakunobholela, “Unyangwii mbone.”

Peniya Yecho ajhakughalambukila mwikeghe jhola na kunobholela Simone, “Bho, mumwene mwikeghe jhonjo, naha ndeka? Bhahe, nenga punyingila pakajha pino mukambekihe ndeka mache gha kughololela makongono ghango, nambo mwikeghe jhonjo akagholwile makongono ghango kwa mahole ghake na kuhunguu kwa majhunjo ghake.
Mwenga unyambwiche ndeka kwa kunjopa, nambo mwikeghe jhonjo punyingila tuu pambano alekite jhe kuchopa makongono ghango.
Nambo mwenga ukambakijhe mahuta pamuto gwango, mwikeghe jhonjo ambakite mahuta gighanungilila petelele makongono ghango.
Bhahe, ninobholela mwikeghe jhonjo chakaka alekekekiwe uhakaho gwamahele ndi nhwalo alangie ughano nkolongwa, nambo jwalekekewa pandina, jwenio upala pandina.”
Papalapala Yecho ajhakughalambukila mwikeghe jhola, “Uhakaho gwino ghoha ulekekiwe.”
Bhando bhala bhakibha nabho pakulyegha bhajhakukonyana, “Bho, ndi mundo ghane hojho jwahoto kulekekeya uhakaho?”
Jwenio Yecho ajhakunobholela mwikeghe jhola, “Kihobholelo chino kikombwile, nnyende kwa uteeke.”
